setup.body: GoClaw uses your own Google OAuth client (bring your own client). One-time setup:
setup.step1: Create an OAuth client (type "Web application") in the Google Cloud console.
setup.step2: Publish the app to production (unverified is fine) so refresh tokens do not expire after 7 days.
setup.step3: Enter the Client ID and Client Secret below and press Save — the credentials are stored encrypted and this form will not appear again.
